_about: Tidebreak round 4 (HUD): side colours, like team jerseys (the owner's FEEL list: "side colours in mirror matches"; critic_r2 backlog item 5). RingSides (scripts/ring/ring_sides.gd) reads it. In a mirror match (an element worn on both sides) team 1 wears its element's AWAY dress: the same ring garments (the catalog's set ring, nothing new, nothing drawn on anyone), only their cloth colours changed: the element's family kept, its trims and its value turned round. The player's side is always home and the player's own dress never changes (PlayerAppearance.ring_dress). The plates' 2 px side rule and life glyphs take colour(team): the element's home colour, or its away colour for a side wearing away. always: true puts team 1 in its away dress in every ring match, not only in mirrors (the owner's call; default false). The duel and the open world never read this (no ring match: home).
_team_colours: A team format (2v2, 4v4; the owner, 2026-10-10: "Triple AAA"): each side's own colour on the plates' rule and life pips and on the match screen, whatever its fighters' elements (a side of four is of several): home the player's side (the menus' accent teal), away the other (a coral no element wears). The element still shows by its mark beside each name.
_elements: per element: home (the plates' colour for a side in the element's own dress), away (the plates' colour for a side in the away dress: its trim's), away_dress (slot -> zone -> palette token or #hex, merged over ring_team_a's element_dress colours for that slot; the garments themselves are the home dress's)

earth._away: bone and umber against ochre and moss: a bone tunic with umber bands, bone trousers with umber shin wraps, an umber sash, bone arm wraps

water._away: ice and navy against sea blue: an ice-blue parka with navy seams over frost trousers, a navy belt, ice boots

fire._away: warm ivory against charcoal: dark collar and bands, copper sash trim

air._away: rust and umber against pale lilac: a rust tunic with cream bands, umber trousers with rust bands, a cream sash

_metric: the review lineup's check (tools/ring/r4_hud_shots.gd sides): the OKLab dE (x100) between the two sides' mean garment colour at 25 m is at least min_delta_e, and their OKLab L differs by at least min_value_diff
